name: Crawlbase
tagline: Proxy crawl API for scraping and crawling websites at scale
description: Crawlbase is a proxy-based web scraping and crawling API that handles rotating proxies, CAPTCHAs, and headless browsers so developers can fetch rendered or raw HTML from target URLs via simple HTTP requests. It offers scraping, crawler, and related endpoints for data extraction workflows without managing infrastructure.

auth.details: Token query parameter (token=YOUR_API_TOKEN) from dashboard; separate tokens for normal and JavaScript requests.

use_cases: scrape HTML of a URL through residential proxies
crawl multi-page sites with automatic retries
bypass basic anti-bot blocks for data extraction
